subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: By virtue of being readers we are also writers, I now believe, but that was not always the case.
By vertue of being readers we are also writers, I now believe, but that was not always the case.
By virtue of being readers we are also riters, I now believe, but that was not always the case.
By virtue of being readers we are also writers, I now beleive, but that was not always the case.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"virtue"** means behavior showing high moral standards or a beneficial quality or power of a thing. (सद्गुण, गुण)

 
 
• **Example: **Patience is a** virtue** that many people strive to develop.
 
 
 
• **"believe"** refers to accepting something as true; feeling sure of the truth of. (विश्वास करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She **believes** in the power of positive thinking.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vertue** (गुण): Incorrect spelling of "virtue".

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: By vertue of being kind, he was loved by all.
 
 
 
• **Riters** (लेखक): Incorrect spelling of "writers".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Famous riters have influenced many generations.
 
 
 
• **Beleive** (विश्वास करना): Incorrect spelling of "believe".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: I beleive in hard work and dedication.
